definitions.explanation: A ceremony held in January for those who turned 20 during the past year.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}に{振袖|ふりそで}を{着|き}る。
examples.english: To wear furisode for the coming-of-age ceremony.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}は1{月|がつ}の{第|だい}2{月曜日|げつようび}に{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: The coming-of-age ceremony is held on the second Monday of January.

examples.japanese: {成人式|せいじんしき}で{同級生|どうきゅうせい}に{会|あ}えた。
examples.english: I was able to meet classmates at the coming-of-age ceremony.

notes:
{成人式|せいじんしき} is Japan's Coming of Age Day ceremony.

DATE:
Held on the second Monday of January ({成人|せいじん}の{日|ひ}).

ATTIRE:
- Women: {振袖|ふりそで} (long-sleeved kimono)
- Men: スーツ or {袴|はかま}

NOTE:
In 2022, the age of adulthood was lowered to 18, but ceremonies still often celebrate those turning 20.
